note: Committed baseline for `pnpm eval`. recordedAt=null means no live baseline has been recorded yet — run `pnpm eval -- --update-baseline` against live models to populate it. Scores are per fixture/persona case: mean rubric score per dimension over N runs, sampled depends_on edge validity, and mean end-to-end latency. Regression = a mean falling below the thresholds in scripts/eval-explanations.ts; the judge model is pinned in models.json (eval_judge) so scores stay comparable.
